promptRecord.format: Each call used these labeled fields in order: Use case, Asset type, Primary request, Input images, Subject and identity, Composition, Scene and backdrop, Style, Constraints.
promptRecord.commonIntent: Replace the current programmatic icon while preserving only its authored object identity. Paint one complete tangible subject at about 72 percent fill on an opaque dark vignette in the premium hand-painted classic dark-fantasy MMORPG inventory style, with warm top-left key light, cool bottom-right shadow, safe padding, and 22px plus circular-crop legibility.
promptRecord.commonNegative: No text, letters, numbers, labels, runes, pseudo-writing, UI chrome, rarity frame, halo, watermark, signature, checkerboard, transparency, split sheet, collage, hand, mannequin, environmental scene, or cropped silhouette. Pattern vellum must be completely blank, with no diagrams, drafting lines, or marks.
promptRecord.note: Each item's exactPrompt preserves payload.item.revisedPrompt byte-for-byte from its completed image-generation event. promptBrief remains a human-readable index only.

review.verdict: All requested identities remain legible at delivery sizes and inside the circular crop. All pattern faces are blank and identity is carried by material samples, seals, binding, and parcel silhouette.
